lead.description: the 1853 Brussels meeting that opened a series of attempts to make national statistics comparable

self_checks.title: Opening date
self_checks.prompt: On what date did the congress open, and which commission called it?
self_checks.answer: It opened on 19 September 1853. The Central Statistical Commission of Belgium called it, with Quetelet presiding.

self_checks.title: Length of the series
self_checks.prompt: Nine congresses run from 1853 to 1876. How many years separate those two dates, and how long would each gap be if the eight intervals were equal?
self_checks.answer: The dates are 23 years apart. Equal gaps would be 23/8 = 2.875 years.

self_checks.title: Pooled rate
self_checks.prompt: Two compatible tables have 80 events among 200 people and 90 events among 300 people. What is the pooled rate?
